title: Conversation 2026-10-29: SRS for LiveWyer ingress knowledge gathering

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The owner pointed Claude Code at dodwyer/livewyer-ingress, a private repository in which Dave scans conference talks for business opportunities (transcripts, quote-anchored findings per talk). The owner asked what SRS would add to that knowledge gathering, framed as dogfooding and a tech demo, and asked Claude Code to work autonomously and produce something.
